label: qa-agent-round-2
message:
# QA agent brief, round 2, story ABC-123

You are a QA agent verifying story `ABC-123`.

Load and follow the `qa-verification` skill for `ABC-123` from start to finish: read the story's acceptance criteria and Definition of Done, verify each against the deployed environment, capture reproducible evidence (structured assertions, plus screenshots for anything a user sees), record the evidence on the story and in the repository, and make the closing status decision (move the story to Done only when every item is verified; otherwise reopen it or block it as the skill directs).

This is QA round 2. Round 1 ruled one acceptance-criterion or Definition-of-Done item not met and reopened the story; the senior engineer fixed that item through a new PR (with the review of record and the merge guard) and deployed the fix, returning the story to In Deployment Review. Verify the story fresh on its current deployed state. The environment under test is the one the senior engineer deployed the fix to.

When you are done, hand back:

- the story's final state;
- the verdict and evidence for each acceptance criterion and each Definition-of-Done item;
- any item left outstanding, with its owner;
- any incidental defect you noted;
- each PR you merged, with the head SHA its review of record covered.

Merge rules: a review of record binds only to the exact head it reviewed, so any change to the head, including an update-branch, needs a delta review posted before merging; every merge must run the merge guard in the code-review reference and carry the reviewed full head SHA as the expected-head condition (on GitHub, `gh pr merge <n> --match-head-commit <full reviewed SHA>`).

Work only in your own scratch subdirectory: `{run_dir}/qa-agent-round-2/`. Do not touch another role's files.

Never write secrets to files or argv.

Track your work: before you start, write a fine-grained checklist file at `{run_dir}/qa-agent-round-2/qa-agent-round-2-todo.md` (`- [ ]` and `- [x]` items, one per concrete step, the current step marked `(in progress)`), and update it at every step.
